name: Fresh cream
storage: Unopened: cool, dry cupboard. Opened: transfer to a covered container and refrigerate, use within 2–3 days. Freezing works for cooking use (up to 1 month) but it may split.
looksLike: thick, white, pourable cream in a small tetra pack (Amul Fresh Cream, about 25% fat); thickens further in the fridge.
howToPick: tetra pack not bulged or dented, well within date. When opened it should be smooth and white with a clean milky smell; sour smell or lumps with watery liquid mean it has turned.
shelfLife: UHT tetra about 4–6 months unopened at room temperature (check pack); 2–3 days after opening, refrigerated.
substitutes: Homemade malai (cream skimmed from boiled full-cream milk)
Whisked thick curd added off the heat

usedIn.raw: 15 ml (1 tbsp), swirled in at the end.
